[center][size=5][b][color=#FFD921]📦 Stack Everything Redux [Unofficial] for Stardew Valley 🌱[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[b][color=#59C9F1]Stack Everything Redux[/color][/b] is an awesome mod that supercharges your item stacking experience in [i][color=#59C9F1]Stardew Valley[/color][/i]! Say goodbye to clutter because now you can stack all sorts of items that normally don't stack, like [color=#90D26D]Furniture[/color], [color=#90D26D]Tackles[/color], and [color=#90D26D]Wallpapers[/color]. Not only that, you can go beyond the default limit of 999 by customizing the max stack amount in the mod's settings.
— But wait, there's more! This mod also introduces a handy input method ([b]SHIFT+Right Click[/b]) for easily selecting the amount you need when buying, crafting,
cooking, or splitting stacked items. It's like magic for your inventory!

[b][size=4][color=#FFD921]Key Features:[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b][color=#59C9F1]Expanded Stacking Capability[/color]:[/b] Stack items that are not stackable by default, including [color=#90D26D]Furniture[/color], [color=#90D26D]Tackles[/color], and [color=#90D26D]Wallpapers[/color].
[*] [b][color=#59C9F1]Modify Default Max Amount[/color]:[/b] Customize the default maximum stack amount beyond 999 for improved item management.
[*] [b][color=#59C9F1]Enhanced Input Selection[/color]:[/b] Adds a convenient input method ([b]SHIFT+Right Click[/b]) to select desired amounts when buying, crafting, cooking, or splitting stacked items.
[/list]
[b][size=4][color=#FFD921]Configuration Options:[/color][/size][/b]
The [i]Stack Everything Redux[/i] mod offers versatile configuration options:

[list]
[*] [b][color=#59C9F1]MaxStackingNumber[/color]:[/b] Set the maximum stack amount for every stackable item.
[*] [b][color=#59C9F1]DefaultCraftingAmount[/color]:[/b] Specify the default amount for [b]SHIFT+Right Click[/b] in cooking/crafting menus.
[*] [b][color=#59C9F1]DefaultShopAmount[/color]:[/b] Determine the default amount for [b]SHIFT+Right Click[/b] in shop menus.
[*] [b][color=#59C9F1]EnableStackSplitRedux[/color]:[/b] Enable or disable Split Redux functionalities.
[/list]
The [i]Stack Everything Redux[/i] mod integrates with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy in-game configuration. You can adjust settings by editing [i]config.json[/i] in the mod's folder.

[b][size=4][color=#FFD921]Note:[/color][/size][/b]
Certain items like tools, hats, rings, boots, and weapons remain unstackable due to technical constraints.

[b][size=4][color=#FFD921]Inspiration & Credits:[/color][/size][/b]
The development of [i]Stack Everything Redux[/i] was inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/44734342]CatCattyCat[/url]'s "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2053]Stack Everything[/url]" mod and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/27024274]pepoluan[/url]'s "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8967]Stack Split Redux[/url]" mod.
